notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator - Building system
notes.notes:
[b]Hello blacksmiths,[/b]
 Today we want show you our building system.

[previewyoutube=n8Mg_8ONtkA;full][/previewyoutube]

First when you get to Alduran's Gate you need to set up your forge, 
some basic items you get for free, but also you can buy some additional, like table, bed, shelf etc.

Green squares shows you that nothing is blocking this position, if you place it and don't like current location, you can pick it up again by using a crowbar.

The shelves give you the chance to place whatever you want on them.

If you have any questions, go ahead ask us everything!

[b]
Our Discord [url=]https://discord.gg/fXc7ZrE[/url][/b]

notes.title: Ironsmith - Alduran's Gate outskirts
notes.notes:
Hello fellow blacksmiths,


Today we would like to show you a short video of an area on the new map that is included in our main game 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978700/Ironsmith_Medieval_Simulator/

This part are Alduran's Gate outskirts which includes farms, mines and rural areas.  

Alduran's Gate city has its name because of the ancient tale about a dragon who had his nest in the mountains nearby. As people fled from the threat, they reached exactly this place, the dragon helped the fugitives chase away their enemies and allowed them to build a city. From that day, Aldur the dragon is worshipped by the people who lives in the city.

[previewyoutube=C0t7mK70C_8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ironsmith medieval simulator - Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello blacksmiths,[/b]

In this quick update we addressed problems you informed us about on them forum.

[i][b]We have fixed following issues:[/b][/i]

- Crash of the game should no longer occur when the ingot has heat of 100%

- Crash of the game should no longer occur when the ingot is picked up by pincers when hot. 

- You can now correctly get drunk in the tavern in Willow Wood (We noticed this problem on your Youtube videos, where you went to tavern but drinking gave no effects).


So enjoy blacksmiths, go to our tavern and try to forge steel when drunk!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37899060/4910613050e6bacf9a5464e8e5721c32b9eba88e.jpg[/img]

Remember to check our main app,
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978700/Ironsmith_Medieval_Simulator/

notes.title: Ironsmith medieval simulator Prolog - Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello blacksmiths,
[/b]
We made a quick hotfix based on your feedback.

[b]The changes are:[/b]


- Drastically reduced game size (24 GB was definitely too big...)

- No longer falling off the map on the first map of the prologue,

- We corrected some of the lightning problems,

- If you have VR headset you should no longer get announcment about VR

- Mouse smoothing changed to disabled by default.

[i][b]Because we changed the game's size, you may need to reinstall it to avoid bugs.[/b][/i]
(Sorry for that, but there was no other option)

Remember to check our main app,
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978700/Ironsmith_Medieval_Simulator/
